title: Hullproof Engine per requirement results (results.json)
description: The JSON form the kit gate (hullproof-gate.mjs, loadResults) already reads: an array of {id, result, notes}, sorted by id, one row per requirement ID.

result.pattern: ^(FAIL|PASS \(static\)|NOT APPLICABLE|NOT ASSESSED: (NEEDS DASHBOARD|NEEDS BUILD|NEEDS DYNAMIC TEST|ASK OWNER|ATTESTATION|UNKNOWN))$

notes.description: NOT APPLICABLE needs a reason here. Plain text, no secret values.
